blocks.title: The big idea
blocks.body: A variable is a letter for a number. Expressions combine variables and numbers, and equations say two expressions are equal. Solving means undoing operations step by step to get the variable alone.

blocks.title: Parts of an expression
items: Term: a piece separated by $+$ or $-$
Coefficient: the number multiplying a variable
Constant: a term with no variable
Like terms have the same variable part

blocks.title: Inequalities
items: Flip the sign if you multiply or divide by a negative

blocks.body: Check your answer by substituting it into the original equation or inequality.
